message.reasoning_content:
need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts.

Facts: Yang used his position as village committee (village head?) to divert village funds (pre-collected construction fees) 140,000 RMB and later 51,765 RMB for personal business expenses (eye glasses factory). He later returned the funds to village account. He was summoned and presumably self-surrendered.

This is classic "挪用公款" (misappropriation of public funds) or "挪用资金". The list includes both "挪用公款" and "挪用资金". Need to decide which is appropriate. In examples, they used "挪用公款" for cases where a public official misappropriated public funds. Example: earlier case with Wang3 (school cashier) they labeled "挪用公款". Another example: Zhou (林某) used position in forest bureau to misappropriate funds, labeled "挪用公款". Another example: Lin (林某) used position in company to misappropriate funds, labeled "挪用资金". Let's see difference: "挪用公款" is for public funds (state, public). "挪用资金" maybe for non-public (private) funds? In example: Lin (林某) was a business employee (company) using position to misappropriate company funds, labeled "挪用资金". So for village committee (public entity) it's public funds, so "挪用公款". Also there is "职务侵占" for public officials who embezzle public property? In examples, "职务侵占" used for bank employee using position to embezzle (like Li). But "挪用公款" is more specific for misappropriation of public funds for personal use, with later return. So answer: [罪名]挪用公款<eoa>

Check if any other charges: maybe "自首" but not a charge. So single charge.

Thus final answer.
